message.content:
**Pantone Color Code for Sky Blue**

| System | Pantone Code | Description |
|--------|--------------|-------------|
| **Pantone Fashion, Home & Interiors (FHI)** | **14‑4318 TCX** | Officially named “Sky Blue” in the FHI catalog. |
| **Pantone Matching System (PMS)** | **PMS 290 C** | A close match in the traditional PMS range, often used for printing. |

> **Note:** Pantone 14‑4318 TCX is the most widely recognized reference for “Sky Blue” across fashion, interior design, and graphic design contexts. If you’re working in print, PMS 290 C is the corresponding spot color.
